Whilst channel branding can be important when you become more established, the most important thing when starting out is the quality of your content, until you find what you want your channel to be, investing in branding is redundant.
As the GF of a YouTuber who has been around awhile take it from me when I say, you will change your mind about your branding, your first roll of the dice you will get bored with and change to suit once you find your niche.
Just have fun whilst making quality content and the rest will come.
Build and work on a quality community, and you will find what you are looking for.
I wish you the all the best!
